### Coverage note — slice `fakedesk-fidelity` (15 findings)
Read in full: src/x32mcp/fakedesk.py (1368 lines, top to bottom), docs/REVIEW_BRIEF.md, docs/HANDOVER.md, docs/research/meters.md (all), docs/research/transport.md (all), docs/research/fx_routing_scenes.md §2 (GEQ), §3 (inserts), §13 + verification log (UNCONFIRMED list), scales_params.md §12.4/§17 (headamp, UNCONFIRMED list); src/x32mcp/meters.py (SyntheticRta, LiveMeters, average_frames, set_rta_source, lin_to_db, METER_GROUPS), src/x32mcp/cfs.py (module contract, _calibrate_floor, _open_session, _arm/_disarm, _consume, _run_ringout, _notch_and_verify, _verify_decay), src/x32mcp/detector.py (config, growth/onset guard, NotchController.plan/band_for_freq), src/x32mcp/provision.py (all), src/x32mcp/desk.py (scenes, get_fx, get_inserts, headamp_index_for, _write, label, panic, recall/save_scene, set_insert, set_fx_type, set_geq_band), src/x32mcp/connection.py (request/retry, set, slash, _handle_datagram, cache), policy.validate_notch, device.yaml rta/geq/detector/ringout sections; tests/integration/conftest.py, test_cfs.py (fixtures, provisioning, discover, watch/ring_out closed loops, floor calibration test), test_fakedesk.py (meters, closed loop, scenes list), test_server_tools.py (meters/rta, CFS tool test headers), tests/test_nodes.py VERBATIM section (parser IS tested against verbatim desk lines from transport.md §6.3/§6.4 — the parser/renderer closed loop is mitigated for reads; it remains for '/'-write acceptance, which the fake parses with our own parse_node_line, fakedesk.py:722-746, and M5 verified only 3 restored sections). Ran: a detector latency-vs-growth-rate script (15/40/80/150 dB/s → detected after 2.05/0.8/0.6/0.45 s at -11.8/-14.3/-12.0/-3.0 dB) and 5 committed probe tests in worktree $SP/worktrees/fakedesk-fidelity (branch wt/fakedesk-fidelity, commit fd2c0d3, tests/integration/test_fidelity_probes.py) — all 5 fail on HEAD as designed (floor calibration never runs via LiveMeters; set_rta_source leaves peakhold/decay/gain; Main LR planned as GEQ2 side A only; 120 dB/s ring detected at -1.0 dB; slow /save duplicated ×2 and misreported). Not read: webui.py, patches.py internals, osc.py, most of scales.py, server.py beyond get_meters/get_rta/_RtaPrefsWriter, test_detector.py bodies, fx_routing_scenes §4-§11 bodies (skimmed headings/UNCONFIRMED only). Report index: $SP/reports/assumptions-fakedesk-fidelity/README.txt.

Ten highest-value FakeDesk 'realism switches' (all default OFF; test each would break when ON): (1) apply_delay_ms — SETs and '/' writes become visible to GET, /node and the RTA only after N ms (models the desk's asynchronous apply; breaks test_apply_setup_validates_and_is_idempotent, test_label_channel read-back, every settle()-by-GET helper in test_cfs/test_fakedesk — the known HANDOVER §4b/#5 class). (2) rta_display — honour /-prefs/rta/decay (fall-rate limit), peakhold, gain offset and autogain normalisation in /meters/15 (breaks test_feedback_watch_closed_loop and test_ring_out_closed_loop because the fake default autogain is ON, fakedesk.py:159, and with peakhold set). (3) insert_tap — cuts reach the analyser only through a PRE insert relative to /-prefs/rta/pos (breaks test_geq_notch_kills_ring_closed_loop, which provisions POST at test_fakedesk.py:410, and test_cfs.py:207). (4) stereo_strip — main/st and buslink-ed pairs consume both sides of an FX slot; dual GEQ side A = left leg only, RTA sees the average (breaks test_plan_setup_allocates_slot_5_l_r main expectation and any main ring-out). (5) insert_exclusivity + /-insert/* read-back with 'steal' or 'refuse' modes (breaks test_validate_reports_bypassed_insert… lines 203-207 and test_fakedesk.py:431). (6) physical_ring — ring parameterised by loop_delay_ms/excess_db, GEQ bell response per RTA band, decay only when effective cut > excess (breaks the l2 < l1-3 timing assertions and single -3 dB VERIFY passes in test_cfs, and exposes the growth_max onset guard). (7) inbound_loss_rate / rx_burst_capacity (breaks test_panic_mutes_24_outputs_fast's fakedesk-state check, notch par assertions, dump completeness at concurrency 16). (8) frame_jitter/burst delivery + coarse-clock option for LiveMeters (breaks detector timing when driven through LiveMeters; cfs duplicate-ts drop discards clumped frames). (9) input_signal_model — per-preamp connected/ambient level, -100/-128 floors, channel meters pre-fader (breaks test_meter_frames_decode 'muted: silence' at test_fakedesk.py:286-288; enables the discover_mics meter cross-check test). (10) scene/show realism — scenes carry fx types/inserts/GEQ pars/faders/routing, recall takes ~800 ms with pushes and optional GET stalls, show_control default CUES, prepos -1 at boot, save_latency_ms (breaks test_list_scenes_current_scene_recall_and_save, test_recall_scene_by_index_and_name_and_save_dance, and duplicates /save under the 0.25 s test timeout). Runners-up: fx type load resets all 64 pars to the effect defaults and takes time (fake keeps raw values, fakedesk.py:1044/_store, so old DES2 raws read as phantom GEQ cuts — the fake is LESS convenient here); truncate names to 12 chars in the fake (M5); independent /-ha/NN/index; /-stat/rtasource computed from an independent table with a 'stale after reset' mode. Weaker items dropped (9): /-stat/rtasource mirror is the same formula as rta_stat_expected (closed loop, but M7 verified 168 live); single-leaf /node engineering-text format UNCONFIRMED (production never reads single leaves); _coerce accepts strings on float addresses and floats on int addresses (production never sends them); 4-client /xremote cap and lease loss after one dropped heartbeat (cache TTL bounds staleness); /-action/setrtasrc rewriting /-prefs/rta/source is UNCONFIRMED (unused by production); GET on a node container answering all values typed (unused); panic 'silences outputs' only for POST/+M-tapped outputs and not direct-outs/monitor/aux taps (fx_routing_scenes §11, default tap UNCONFIRMED) — acknowledged in the panic docstring, no output-tap model in the fake, belongs to the safety slice; show_control default SCENES vs the real desk's CUES and slash()/send_raw() not publishing 'write' (lead reviewer's items); the settle()-by-GET helper (test_cfs.py:77-79, test_fakedesk.py:406) is the known read-after-write example. Note on finding 5 vs REVIEW_BRIEF §4: the calibration was NOT fully backed out — commits 56c34a7/60b86d5 left _calibrate_floor wired into _open_session where it can only ever fire for an injected, already-running source (which is exactly what test_cfs_tools_with_injected_synthetic_rta provides, and plausibly why that test alone changed behaviour).
